g1|core|pricing|standard condition recor.title: Standard Condition Record Pricing (PR00)
g1|core|pricing|standard condition recor.story: Imagine a giant cash register that automatically knows the exact price of every item sold by looking up secret price tags stored in a giant filing cabinet. In SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash (OTC), standard condition record pricing calculates the net value of a sales order by reading condition technique elements like access sequences, condition tables, and pricing procedures. When a sales representative creates a customer order, the system searches through condition records for condition type PR00, applies the valid price, and passes the calculated monetary amounts down to outbound delivery and billing documents. If this pricing engine is misconfigured, sales orders show zero prices, billing documents fail to generate accounting postings, and company revenue reporting breaks completely.
g1|core|pricing|standard condition recor.why_business_needs_it: Automated standard pricing ensures that every customer receives accurate, legally compliant prices based on customer and material combinations without manual intervention. It drives the financial backbone of the Order-to-Cash process by feeding precise revenue values into billing and General Ledger (GL) postings.

g1|core|pricing|scale pricing by quantit.title: Scale Pricing by Quantity (PR00 with Scales)
g1|core|pricing|scale pricing by quantit.story: Just like buying a big box of chocolates makes each chocolate cheaper, SAP gives lower prices per unit when customers buy more items at once. Technically, condition type PR00 evaluates quantity scale levels defined in condition records using calculation type C (Graduated/Interval scale) within pricing procedure RVAA01 to automatically discount order items based on tier thresholds.
g1|core|pricing|scale pricing by quantit.why_business_needs_it: Volume-based tiered pricing incentivizes larger purchase orders to increase total revenue and sales volume while maintaining competitive pricing for wholesale buyers. Without interval scales, sales teams must manually adjust line-item prices, leading to pricing errors and lost sales velocity.

g1|core|pricing|advanced variant pricing.title: Advanced Variant Pricing (Characteristics-based)
g1|core|pricing|advanced variant pricing.story: Imagine a magical car customizer where adding a giant spoiler or heated seats instantly recalculates the final price based on the exact parts chosen. In SAP S/4HANA Sales, Advanced Variant Pricing uses variant configuration characteristics to dynamically drive condition values into the pricing procedure. When a sales order is created for a configurable material, the characteristics selected in the configuration profile feed condition records via access sequence VA00 using condition type VA00. This ensures complex, made-to-order products price accurately without manual intervention.
g1|core|pricing|advanced variant pricing.why_business_needs_it: Companies selling highly configurable products cannot maintain pre-calculated prices for every possible combination of features. Advanced Variant Pricing automates price derivation based on product characteristics, preventing revenue leakage and pricing errors during order entry.
